domain: Industrial/engineering and medical document reading: SPC control charts (filling heads), data-centre fiber patching, sleep study + EEG, roadway earthwork cross sections
python_version: 3.12 (3.11 also used by the xsec Dockerfile)
known_issues: Tennis: two received task sets (received/tennis3d: 5 hard; received/tennis_v3: 10 easy); generator code not available, so not in the adapter
xsec: adapter sets noise=0 because noisy PNGs are ~16 MB (over Anthropic's 10 MB image limit)
xsec: fill_total questions never pass the generator's own +/-5% reading check, so they are excluded
xsec: only 1 validated seed per xsec question type (its validator rejects many seeds; the dashed ground line trips its ink check)
heads_first_signal answer is a sequence [head, sample]; models should answer 'head, sample' (e.g. 3, 46)
Brain tasks use 1-2 images; extra images are listed in an 'images' field, 'image' is the first
